description: Gets a fresh, itemized all-in price and availability for one offer_id (from find_cheaper or search_stays) for specific dates and guests. Returns a quote_id that book needs; it stays valid for 15 minutes.

check_out.description: Check-out date (the morning the traveler leaves), YYYY-MM-DD

infants.description: Guests under 2; they don't count toward capacity. Default 0

offer_id.description: The offer_id from a find_cheaper or search_stays result
